system.description: You twirl your Weapon around you in a blur, creating a circle of death around you. Any enemy target that begins its turn adjacent to you takes damage equal to your Strength bonus. You must be wielding a Melee Weapon to be using this Talent.

prerequisite.text: Melee Smash talent, and Unrelenting Assault talent

nodes.text: Melee Smash talent, and Unrelenting Assault talent
